rationale: The last five candles show a clear deterioration from the entry thesis — price has rolled from ~$141.20 down to $140.36, with the most recent candle posting a sharp drop to $140.12 intrabar and closing at $140.36, well below the 9-EMA ($140.52) and approaching the invalidation level at $139.90. Volume spiked significantly on the down candle (101,927 vs prior ~35-42k), indicating distribution rather than absorption. The staircase of higher lows that justified the entry has broken, and with SPY negative and VIXY elevated, the risk/reward no longer favors holding into a likely stop-out.
